title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1974-10-20
source: Lineage: 16 track "truck monitor mix" > 2 track mixdown reel(Garcia's) > R @ 3 3/4 ips; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC; Tranfered December 2014 by Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: A vibrant 1974‑era show highlighted by jazzy "Playing in the Band" jams and a solo Jack Straw, captured on an unspecified but listenable source.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the musical side of this performance – noting Keith’s jazz‑inflected playing on “Playing in the Band,” Brent’s bluesy organ feel, Donna’s Ella‑Fitzgerald style vocals, and a striking solo rendition of Jack Straw. No concrete details about the recording source are given, but the enthusiasm suggests the audio is at least adequate for enjoying these moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and praise the musical performance strongly; lack of recording‑quality comments keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not mention soundboard, audience bleed, or any audio flaws, implying an acceptable listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight jazzy improvisational spots typical of the ’74 era, with a notable solo moment on Jack Straw that adds variety to the set.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s jazz‑jam contributions are specifically praised as a highlight of the performance.
